weaknesses.title: WRITEATOMIC renames new inode — severs HARDLINK share
weaknesses.detail: After HARDLINK, put WRITEATOMIC leaves alias on old inode/content; primary is new inode. Agents expect shared update; get silent fork. No WRITEATOMIC-in-place or re-hardlink helper.
weaknesses.repro: link; put v2; primary=v2 alias=v1 different inodes

weaknesses.title: HARDLINK dest-exists soft fail; no force/replace
weaknesses.detail: Republish must RM alias then HARDLINK (TOCTOU). Same class as SYMLINK no-force.
weaknesses.repro: HARDLINK src dst twice → second OK=0

weaknesses.title: No cross-device HARDLINK diagnostic plate field

weaknesses.title: DIRSYNC missing leaf still syncs parent OK

weaknesses.title: HARDLINK vs SYMLINK agent confusion
weaknesses.detail: release_pointer uses SYMLINK (peelable); this board hardlinks (mutate-all). No help matrix.
